platforms.title: Shopify & Shopify Plus
platforms.text: Fast to market, cheap to operate, and a checkout that converts because Shopify spends more on optimising it than any single merchant could.
platforms.bestText: Your complexity is commercial rather than structural — merchandising, promotions, multi-market, DTC growth — and you'd rather spend engineering budget on selling than on hosting.

platforms.title: Adobe Commerce & Magento
platforms.text: Control over everything, including the parts you'd rather not own. Still the right answer when your rules genuinely can't be expressed in a SaaS platform.
platforms.bestText: Complexity lives in the catalogue, in ERP-driven pricing, or in B2B rules with real approval hierarchies — and you need backend control that a managed platform won't give you.

neutralText: A replatform is the most expensive answer to most commerce problems. If your issue is checkout friction or a missing integration, we'll say so — even though the smaller project is the less profitable one for us.

mos.label: 2.4.6 or earlier
mos.heading: Outside the supported window
mos.text: Security patching has ended for these lines on Open Source. Worth reviewing before it becomes a compliance question.

mos.heading: Supported, worth planning
mos.text: You have runway, but the upgrade belongs in this budget cycle rather than the next one.

mos.label: 2.4.8 or 2.4.9
mos.heading: Current
mos.text: You're on a supported line. Keep to the patch cadence and revisit in 2027.

mos.label: Magento 1 / not sure
mos.heading: Needs a review
mos.text: Magento 1 has been unsupported since 2020. This is worth a conversation soon.

ac.label: 2.4.6 or earlier
ac.heading: Check your entitlement
ac.text: Licensed Adobe Commerce carries extended cover that Open Source doesn't. Teams get this wrong in both directions — verify before deciding.

ac.heading: Supported, worth planning
ac.text: Plan the upgrade in this cycle, and confirm your PHP version separately.

ac.label: 2.4.8 or 2.4.9
ac.heading: Current
ac.text: Supported line. Maintain the patch cadence.

ac.label: On Cloud, not sure
ac.heading: Quick check needed
ac.text: Cloud carries its own upgrade enforcement timeline. Worth confirming against your contract.

shopify.label: Plus, migrated to Extensibility
shopify.heading: Current
shopify.text: You're on the supported path. Worth confirming your tracking survived the migration — silent pixel loss is common.

shopify.label: Plus, not sure
shopify.heading: Worth verifying
shopify.text: Shopify has been auto-upgrading stores without opt-in. Yours may already have moved.

shopify.label: Basic / Grow / Advanced
shopify.heading: Worth a check
shopify.text: Some checkout deadlines apply below Plus too. A short audit settles it.

shopify.label: Not on Shopify yet
shopify.heading: Nothing at risk
shopify.text: No deadline pressure — the question is fit, not urgency.
